verdicts.explanation: The paper reports 1.7·10-2 S cm-1 at 500 K for K-7,8-C2B9H12 with Ea 0.28 eV in the disordered state, measured by EIS in this study. The secondary fields are null, which the paper supports.
The paper reports σ(K+) = 4.3·10-4 S cm-1 at 423 K for commercial KB11H14 in the disordered phase, with Ea 0.38 eV, measured in this work. Origin is experimental and the temperature is correct.
The paper reports σ(K+) = 1.0·10-4 S cm-1 at 400 K for K-7-CB10H13, with the activation energy falling to 0.42 eV in the disordered phase. These are this paper's own EIS measurements.
The sentence cites Souza et al. (Ref. 36) for σ = 1.2·10-4 S cm-1 at 423 K and Ea = 1.9 eV for as-synthesized KB11H14. That makes it literature_cited, not experimental.

The ball-milled KB11H14 value of ~3.5·10-4 S cm-1 at 423 K and Ea 1.5 eV come from Souza et al. (Ref. 36), per the same sentence. The ball-milling synthesis is stated in the Figure 8 caption as the sample condition, so the record is supported.
